summary: Iteration 12 · Operations Workbench (OP-01..OP-06) — 19/20 backend pytest pass (1 OP-01 graceful skip due to known ingress gateway 502 on >60s LLM calls). Full Playwright admin UI sweep + full public /demo ConsoleWorkbenchPanel sweep both PASS. All deterministic labs (OP-02 through OP-06) work end-to-end with real PDF downloads (>5KB, %PDF magic verified) and persistent decision/risk mutations. Public /api/agent/workbench/* wrappers respond cleanly with correct shapes (12 slides, 4 fact sheets, 10 sections, 6 modules, 5 decisions, 7 risks, 8 phases).

minor.issue: LLM call takes 60-90s and the Kubernetes ingress gateway returns 502 before the response lands. Backend itself completes the run (LiteLLM logs show repeated successful claude-sonnet-4-5 streams), but the client never sees the JSON. Treated as known infra limitation per agent_to_agent_context_note. Suggestion: switch to background-job pattern + GET /runs polling, OR pre-warm a cached run + serve the cached PDF on demand.

action_items: OP-01 LLM call exceeds ingress gateway timeout (502 after ~60s). Recommend converting to async background task: POST returns run_id immediately, client polls GET /runs/{id}. Alternatively, pre-generate one cached PDF at boot and have the public/admin endpoint serve the cached file when LLM budget/timeout hits.
Minor UX: OPS·WORKBENCH lab view does not expose a data-testid on the ← BACK button — adding 'data-testid="lab-back-btn"' would simplify future test automation.
critical_code_review_comments: ops_workbench.py (793 lines) is approaching the 700-line guideline — consider splitting into ops_workbench/{roi.py,architecture.py,pitch_deck.py,technical_doc.py,seed.py} in a future refactor pass. Non-blocking.
server.py is now ~5755 lines — overall server modularization is overdue (router-per-domain). Same finding carried from iteration_11.

OP-01 happy path is implemented correctly (LLM stream → JSON parse → PDF generation → DB record + audit) but is functionally unreachable via HTTP because the ingress times out. Either move to async/job pattern or relax response shape to return run_id immediately and stream PDF generation in background.
All public /api/agent/workbench/* endpoints correctly avoid the admin gate — verified by anonymous curl/playwright access.
PDF files are cached on disk (/app/backend/static_workbench) — good for performance. Acceptable; cache is invalidated only by manual deletion which is fine for deterministic content.
